proposed_widenings.name: suppress_critical_hit
proposed_widenings.justification: Adamantine Armor is a passive magic item whose deterministic mechanical effect changes incoming critical hits into normal hits while worn. The existing surface has `modify_crit_range`, but that only changes the threshold for attacks you make to score a critical hit; it does not express suppressing crit status on attacks made against the wearer.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you're wearing it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

notes: The top-level record kind and mechanics family fit honestly as `magic_item` + `passive`, likely with a `wearing_item` gate, but there is no existing effect atom for incoming critical-hit suppression. Authoring this as `modify_crit_range` would be false, so no content/trace files were created.
